name: Pooled junction QC
rule: >= 10 cells and >= 100 reads, both atlases summed

name: Multi-gene junctions removed
rule: Junctions annotated to more than one gene

name: Gene assignment
rule: Junctions with no matching transcript end excluded

name: Splice-site usage
rule: Junction removed if < 1% of reads at either splice site

name: Matched to expression
rule: Cells and genes present in both modalities

name: Cell QC
rule: >= 5 junctions; <= median + 5 MAD on junctions, junction reads, expression counts

name: Event re-derivation
rule: Connected components on surviving junctions; 9,065 singletons dropped
